mapper.select: SELECT id,order_no,buyer_id,vendor_id,buyer_deposit,vendor_deposit,buyer_deposit_status,vendor_deposit_status,status,trip_id FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,applicant_id,applicant_role,reason_type FROM t_cancel_requests WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='pending' AND withdrawn=0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_orders SET status=#{status},cancel_tier=#{tier},cancel_reason_type=#{reason},cancel_force_majeure=#{force},cancel_proof_urls=CAST(#{proof} AS JSON),buyer_deposit_status=#{buyerStatus},vendor_deposit_status=#{vendorStatus},cancel_penalty_amount=#{penalty},closed_reason=#{closedReason},settled_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending','locked','purchased','disputing')
UPDATE t_deposits SET status='refunded',reason=#{reason},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status='frozen'

UPDATE t_cancel_requests SET status=IF(#{approve},'approved','rejected'),verdict=IF(#{approve},'no_fault','continue_fulfill'),verdict_reason=#{reason},reviewed_by=#{op},resolved_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='pending' AND withdrawn=0
UPDATE t_orders SET status='locked',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('requesting','disputing')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_disputes WHERE order_id=#{id} AND stage NOT IN('resolved','closed') FOR UPDATE
SELECT id FROM t_after_sales_cases WHERE order_id=#{id} AND status NOT IN('resolved','closed','rejected','cancelled') FOR UPDATE
